incidents.name: LixirPermitDrain
incidents.notes: Lixir vault-token permit accepted a dummy signature as long as ecrecover returned any nonzero address, so a forged permit granted allowance to drain every holder's shares.

sources.ref: deployment-basis recheck: the victim's 45-byte runtime is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy (363d3d373d3d3d363d73...5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3) whose master 0x2ce186c52cf150000bf8ad2b4679d4ad619395cd is baked into the bytecode and cannot be repointed; callTracer confirms every DELEGATECALL in the attack, including the forged permit (0xd505accf), lands on that master. The clone's runtime is byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks. Deployment is exact; 1800.5 days.
